duration.basis: Covers the two event days of N40 Table 4 (PDF page 20), 11 and 12 Sep 2017: time zero is 11 Sep 00:00 UTC. The event began 10 Sep 16:06 UTC but the ISS stayed in safe orbits until 11 Sep 04:30 (N40 Section 3.3, PDF page 9), so nothing changes before 04:30

scenarios.note: The solar particle event of 10 September 2017 (GLE 72) as the ISS Columbus module saw it (N40, N20). Time zero is 11 Sep 2017 00:00 UTC. The dose rate rises when the protons first reach the ISS (04:30) and adds, day by day, the DOSTEL-2 excess over the 10 Sep quiet day in N40 Table 4: 60.1 uGy on 11 Sep and 7.7 uGy on 12 Sep. The real record replays through the dostel2_spe_2017 feed. The twin has no orbit, so it carries no South Atlantic Anomaly or latitude modulation.

start.basis: 11 Sep 04:30 UTC, when the first SPE protons were seen at the ISS (N40 Section 3.3, PDF page 9)

duration.basis: DosTel2 rows of nasa-data/radiation/radlab_iss_2017-09_spe.csv (N20), samples at absolute latitude at least 45 deg (the high-latitude cut of the case method, nasa-data/cases/spe-2017-09-iss-columbus/outcome.json replay_checks_derived_by_curator), hourly mean against the quiet baseline, the mean of the high-latitude samples of 10 Sep before the 16:06 event start (8.84 uGy/h; 10 Sep is the quiet day N40 takes, Section 3.3): at least twice the baseline from the 04 h to the 12 h hour of 11 Sep (2.2, 5.6, 1.1, 6.6, 4.9, 5.2, 5.7, 4.1, 3.8), 1.7 in the 13 h hour and 1.0 in the 14 h hour, so 04:30 to 14:00

added_dose.basis: N40 Table 4 (PDF page 20), DOSTEL-2: 163.8 uGy on 11 Sep minus 103.7 uGy on the 10 Sep quiet day (absorbed dose in silicon, South Atlantic Anomaly removed)

rise.basis: DosTel2 rows of nasa-data/radiation/radlab_iss_2017-09_spe.csv (N20), samples at absolute latitude at least 45 deg (the high-latitude cut of the case method, nasa-data/cases/spe-2017-09-iss-columbus/outcome.json replay_checks_derived_by_curator), hourly mean against the quiet baseline, the mean of the high-latitude samples of 10 Sep before the 16:06 event start (8.84 uGy/h; 10 Sep is the quiet day N40 takes, Section 3.3): 2.2 times in the 04 h hour, 5.6 times in the 05 h hour of 11 Sep

fall.basis: DosTel2 rows of nasa-data/radiation/radlab_iss_2017-09_spe.csv (N20), samples at absolute latitude at least 45 deg (the high-latitude cut of the case method, nasa-data/cases/spe-2017-09-iss-columbus/outcome.json replay_checks_derived_by_curator), hourly mean against the quiet baseline, the mean of the high-latitude samples of 10 Sep before the 16:06 event start (8.84 uGy/h; 10 Sep is the quiet day N40 takes, Section 3.3): 3.8 times in the 12 h hour, 1.7 in the 13 h hour, 1.0 in the 14 h hour of 11 Sep

start.basis: DosTel2 rows of nasa-data/radiation/radlab_iss_2017-09_spe.csv (N20), samples at absolute latitude at least 45 deg (the high-latitude cut of the case method, nasa-data/cases/spe-2017-09-iss-columbus/outcome.json replay_checks_derived_by_curator), hourly mean against the quiet baseline, the mean of the high-latitude samples of 10 Sep before the 16:06 event start (8.84 uGy/h; 10 Sep is the quiet day N40 takes, Section 3.3): back to the baseline from 11 Sep 14:00 until the 03 h hour of 12 Sep (1.1), so the tail starts 12 Sep 03:00

duration.basis: DosTel2 rows of nasa-data/radiation/radlab_iss_2017-09_spe.csv (N20), samples at absolute latitude at least 45 deg (the high-latitude cut of the case method, nasa-data/cases/spe-2017-09-iss-columbus/outcome.json replay_checks_derived_by_curator), hourly mean against the quiet baseline, the mean of the high-latitude samples of 10 Sep before the 16:06 event start (8.84 uGy/h; 10 Sep is the quiet day N40 takes, Section 3.3): 1.1 to 1.7 times from the 03 h to the 14 h hour of 12 Sep, 0.9 in the 15 h hour, so 03:00 to 15:00

added_dose.basis: N40 Table 4 (PDF page 20), DOSTEL-2: 111.4 uGy on 12 Sep minus 103.7 uGy on the 10 Sep quiet day

rise.basis: DosTel2 rows of nasa-data/radiation/radlab_iss_2017-09_spe.csv (N20), samples at absolute latitude at least 45 deg (the high-latitude cut of the case method, nasa-data/cases/spe-2017-09-iss-columbus/outcome.json replay_checks_derived_by_curator), hourly mean against the quiet baseline, the mean of the high-latitude samples of 10 Sep before the 16:06 event start (8.84 uGy/h; 10 Sep is the quiet day N40 takes, Section 3.3): 1.1 times in the 03 h hour, 1.7 times in the 06 h hour of 12 Sep

fall.basis: DosTel2 rows of nasa-data/radiation/radlab_iss_2017-09_spe.csv (N20), samples at absolute latitude at least 45 deg (the high-latitude cut of the case method, nasa-data/cases/spe-2017-09-iss-columbus/outcome.json replay_checks_derived_by_curator), hourly mean against the quiet baseline, the mean of the high-latitude samples of 10 Sep before the 16:06 event start (8.84 uGy/h; 10 Sep is the quiet day N40 takes, Section 3.3): 1.1 in the 13 h hour, 1.3 in the 14 h hour, 0.9 in the 15 h hour of 12 Sep
